parameters.name: DesignateType
parameters.description: The type of the machines to be designated. Valid values: 1 and 2. The value 1 specifies the worker type. The value 2 specifies the label type.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: The designated `labels`. Specify the value of the parameter in a `JSON` string.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the namespace.

parameters.name: Transferable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to allow a failover.

parameters.name: Workers
parameters.description: The designated machines. Specify the value of the parameter in a JSON string.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 designate-workers --namespace 4a06d5ea-f576-4326-842c-fb14ea043d8d --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id hxm.test --job-id 144153 --transferable true --designate-type 1 --workers 127.0.0.1_,_127.0.0.2 --labels gray --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 DesignateWorkers --region cn-hangzhou --DesignateType 1 --Workers '127.0.0.1_,_127.0.0.2' --NamespaceSource schedulerx --Transferable true --Labels gray --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace '4a06d5ea-f576-4326-842c-fb14ea043d8d' --JobId 144153 --GroupId 'hxm.test'
